notes.title: Version 0.3.0.0 is out
notes.notes: [p]The BOSS system was developed in order to make arena shooter more flexible with different player strategies could be applied attacking bosses. Each boss has permanent per arena bonus. Take the boss out and catch the bonus to make your character stronger, faster, with more health or armored.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, the First chapter was developed so players could enjoy 10 arena levels with different weaves of enemies and challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/c6327d013e39eb4dfa9e35ea62a2f369edecfde5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/eb39b725f937c36c060f82da660cbe04398e089b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/f79f9e2c4ba2ac8a1a923088f12fa86ea18e1a21.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/23a059db2eac9fefd28ff04ba2d0619eb29473d6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/17399b3403ebc9c7549165e9b858266ef5fbe3a3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/7edb81f670023d884f1026f63f6c75aa76e48bfa.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/4607bd6126a0d9cbc37bca8464b37a521b0acd40.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/4de26ad5d8dfbfb5fb59026b729f5d6a16fe0267.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/c1c93898977c68d4971779cccf75a9ae522ef4f6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/649c4c4b522672cffb42edc0e2e0d21cc69dd261.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990664/4f303f68639dbbb02a5e5f79a791f1f160e9d2ae.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Version 0.2.0.0 is out
notes.notes:
Weapons, maps and elements were updated during last months. This update has map scenarios that allows player to receive fight resources like weapons, items and others.

Current build has:
1) More than 20 weapons
2) 6 demo maps
3) Health and armor pickup items
4) 2 demo maps contain models from City of Brass
